page_title: REI 1-0 HAV | Reims v Le Havre 20/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+2' Will Still has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Amadou Kone (Reims) replacing Teddy Teuma.
90+2' Substitution. Ibrahim Diakite (Reims) has come on for Thomas Foket.
90+2' Le Havre failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
86' Stephanie Frappart shows the yellow card to Thomas Foket (Reims) for a heavy challenge.
86' Junya Ito (Reims) had time and space on the edge of the box but sent his effort just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Le Havre.
84' Daler Kuzyaev (Le Havre) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Christopher Operi.
83' Amir Richardson (Reims) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity!
82' Unlucky! A great strike from Keito Nakamura (Reims) near the edge of the box had the keeper scrambling but flew just over the bar.
81' Substitution. Amir Richardson (Reims) on for Reda Khadra.
79' Luka Elsner prepares a substitution. Mohamed Bayo is replaced by Antoine Joujou (Le Havre).
79' Substitution. Oussama Targhalline walks off the pitch and Andre Ayew (Le Havre) comes on as a substitute.
75' Thomas Foket (Reims) is able to continue to play.
74' Thomas Foket (Reims) picks up an injury.
74' The resulting corner, taken by Teddy Teuma (Reims), comes to nothing.
69' The resulting set piece from Reims is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
69' Azor Matusiwa (Reims) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
68' The game is interrupted as Oumar Diakite (Reims) is flagged offside.
65' The manager makes a subsitution with Oumar Diakite (Reims) coming on for Mohamed Daramy.
64' Teddy Teuma (Reims) unleashes a missile of a shot towards goal, but his good effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
62' Christopher Operi (Le Havre) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
60' Emmanuel Agbadou (Reims) tackles a bit over-zealously and Stephanie Frappart blows for a foul.
59' Flag up against Junya Ito (Reims). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
58' Here is a change. Abdoulaye Toure is going off and Luka Elsner gives the last tactical orders to Nabil Alioui (Le Havre).
58' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) replaces Emmanuel Sabbi.
54' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Josue Casimir (Le Havre) is given a yellow card.
54' Yoann Salmier (Le Havre) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
50' Joseph Okumu (Reims) tries to hit a shot towards goal from long range, but he miskicks the ball and it flies high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Le Havre will have a goal kick.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Keito Nakamura (Reims) finds space on the edge of the box, but his wild shot goes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Le Havre.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' Teddy Teuma (Reims) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball is out of play. Reims will have a throw-in.
42' Azor Matusiwa (Reims) commits a foul after making a slide tackle on his opponent.
40' Emmanuel Agbadou (Reims) jumps into a tackle and Stephanie Frappart signals a foul.
39' Reda Khadra (Reims) commits a rough challenge and Stephanie Frappart blows his whistle for an infringement.
37' Mohamed Daramy (Reims) commits a foul and Stephanie Frappart immediately signals a free kick.
34' Junya Ito (Reims) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.

33' Reda Khadra (Reims) produces a good strike that sails towards the right post, but the goalkeeper shows great reflexes and dives to keep the effort from hitting the net. The ball goes behind for a corner. Reims will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
31' Oussama Targhalline (Le Havre) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The linesman signals a throw-in for Le Havre.
31' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 9:2.
29' Teddy Teuma (Reims) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
29' Reims are enjoying possession, but one of the opposition players steps in to end the sequence. The referee blows his whistle, Reims are awarded a corner kick.
25' 1 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Thomas Foket plays it into the box, and Keito Nakamura (Reims) gets on the end of the cross to put it into the bottom right corner. 1:0.
21' Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre) makes an awful challenge on his opponent and is sent off by the referee!
19' Stephanie Frappart blows his whistle. Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre) commits a foul after dangerous play.
17' Emmanuel Agbadou (Reims) leaps highest to meet the resulting set piece and sends his header way off target.
17' Junya Ito (Reims) will deliver the corner kick.

16' Junya Ito (Reims) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Arthur Desmas sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the roof of the net. The ball goes out of play and Reims have been awarded a corner kick.
15' Mohamed Daramy (Reims) unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, but it goes straight at Arthur Desmas.
14' Junya Ito (Reims) is caught offside!
13' Christopher Operi (Le Havre) tested Yehvann Diouf with a strike from just outside the box, but the effort is saved.

12' Arthur Desmas was forced into action to thwart Teddy Teuma (Reims). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the bottom left corner but couldn't beat the keeper.
8' Teddy Teuma (Reims) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
5' Keito Nakamura (Reims) unleashes a decent shot towards goal from long range, but his effort just misses the target.
3' Handball by Christopher Operi (Le Havre).
1' The first half has just begun.
Le Havre will kick the game off.
Stephanie Frappart will supervise the game today.
